# RDF

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Resource Description Framework - a W3C standard model for representing data as subject-predicate-object triples, forming the graph-based foundation for SKOS, OWL, and linked data.

## Scope note

The underlying triple model that SKOS and OWL are built on; pkm-vocab.export.ttl is serialized RDF in Turtle syntax.

## Broader

- [W3C Standard](../W3CStandard/) — generic (ISO 25964)

## This term in RDF

- **URI** — `https://w3id.org/pkm/vocab/RDF` (`pkmv:RDF`)
- **Turtle** — [`terms/RDF.ttl`](../terms/RDF.ttl)
- **Whole vocabulary** — [`pkm-vocab.ttl`](../pkm-vocab.ttl)

That URI serves this page to a browser and RDF to a client that asks for it, so one link works for both:

```
curl -L -H 'Accept: text/turtle' https://w3id.org/pkm/vocab/RDF
```
